explication: pandas is a labeled-data analysis toolkit. A typical workflow starts with an analyst calling the public API, optionally reading tabular data, constructing DataFrame or Series objects, then aligning, indexing, transforming, grouping, windowing, or evaluating expressions before returning labeled results. The tree also documents broad file/database I/O, time-series support, plotting, missing-data handling, reshaping, and interchange. The graph emphasizes sampled runtime modules; several capability nodes have limited wiring because their implementations were not sampled.
